Question B-005-002-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Gold, silver, and aluminum are all metals that conduct well.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Gold, silver and wood": Wood is an insulator, so the group is not three conductors.
- sourceIndex 2: "Copper, aluminum and paper": Paper is an insulator, so the group is not three conductors.
- sourceIndex 3: "Copper, gold and mica": Mica is an insulator, so the group is not three conductors.
